notes.title: Season 3 is here!
notes.content:
Season 3 brings a whole host of new features:

[list]
[*] Two new abilities: Technique and Dodge Chance
[*] Ten new items
[*] Eight new abilities
[*] A DamageMeter that displays the damage dealt in the current and previous rounds
[/list]

and.... Multiplayer! The multiplayer does not include the changes from Season 3, but is currently at the level of Season 2. The multiplayer will be updated in the course of the season.

Last but not least, the updates are now counted differently. Season 3 is now version 1.2. 

Have fun in the new season!

notes.title: Bockito V1.5
notes.content:
A new Bockito Version is here!

Explore new items, a better wave management and a faster gameplay!

notes.title: Weather!
notes.content: Dress warmly, in Bockito there are now different weather effects depending on the season. The effects can be optionally deactivated in the game options.
